title: A4=57 geometry, exact mesh neighborhood, one-photon falsifier, rank-48 tensor, Monster gate, and three chained constructions
result: The 57 support graph is explicitly T(10) disjoint union 2T(4); the one-parameter MacWilliams family gives only t<=245 and therefore does not prove global A4 extremality. All 630 single transpositions of the 36-port order were replayed exactly: none beats 398 rotations, 22 tie it, and all have depth 69. A length-slope/intercept one-photon experiment separates mode-dependent device latency from propagation. The split rank-48 matrix-unit tensor is complete with 178 nonzero structure constants. The Monster gate remains fail-closed. Three constructions separate direct-sum capacity, tensor-product factors, serial speed limits, time-bandwidth packing, and self-similar address density while preserving invariant vacuum c.
